title: Architecture Consultant output
summary: Design the target solution architecture that preserves validated business capabilities. Improve modularity and recommend patterns. Produce architecture-v2 specs and Architecture Decision Records. Never invent business logic.

entries.statement: Target modular boundaries separating real accounting (accounts/transactions) from virtual jar intent (jars/review queue/movements) while preserving household multitenancy.
ADR: Keep jars as virtual intent envelopes derived from jar_movements; do not merge jar balances into account ledgers.
